newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac securitises A$650 mln of loans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac securitises A$650 mln of loans.

text.p: Westpac banking Corp said on Wednesday it had completed the sale of a A$650 million mortgaged backed securities package to two private investors.
Westpac said this was the second deal in its securitisation programme and follows the A$340 million securitisation of a parcel of Westpac's Basic Option home loans in September 1996.

Westpac Group Treasurer, Marten Touw, said the success of the first two transactions was a positive lead-in to a public securitisation offering of mortgage backed securities which was being put together.
"While the current A$650 million issue is a private placement, a public transaction is planned for the second quarter of 1997," Touw said

Touw said this will be distributed by a dealer panel consisting of joint lead managers, Westpac's Institutional & International Banking Group and SBC Warburg Australia Ltd, with Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Australia Ltd as co-manager.
He added that the A$650 million private placement is backed by home loans serviced at the Mortgage Processing Centre in Adelaide.
